title: Custom actions
intro: Connect your business system so customers can look up information or request changes in chat.
denied: Only owners and admins can manage custom actions.
policy: Use a public HTTPS endpoint. Calls have an eight-second limit and a 100 KB response limit. Test each version before enabling it.
loadError: Actions could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
actionError: The action could not be updated. Refresh and try again.
deletePrompt: Delete this action and its pending approvals?
formHelp: Give the bot a precise description and allow only the response fields customers need. Names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
reenter: Editing pauses this action. Re-enter all credentials and headers, then test the new version.
saveError: Could not save. Check names, JSON, credentials, and the identity policy.
name: Action name
description: When should the bot use this action?
urlHelp: Use {parameter_name} in the path or query. The hostname stays fixed. {customer_phone} uses a verified WhatsApp number.
outputHelp: Choose exact JSON paths such as $.stock or $.orders[0].status. Other fields stay out of model results.
allowChanges: I allow this action to change data in the connected system.
confirmCustomer: Require customer confirmation before each change
personal: This action returns or changes personal data
identityPath: Phone or email response JSON path
identityHelp: Phone checks require WhatsApp. Codes go to the email returned by your system and require configured email delivery. For changes, provide a read-only identity lookup first.
testHelp: This test makes a real request. Use synthetic inputs. Raw responses are visible to admins here; the bot receives only the selected fields after identity verification.
testChanges: I approve this test changing data in the connected system.
testError: Could not run the test. Check sample values and connection settings.
testPassed: Test passed. This version can be enabled.
testFailed: Test failed. Check the result before trying again.
historyError: Call history could not be loaded. Refresh actions.

states.unknown: Unknown outcome — check the connected system
